description_html:
Job Title: Accountant

Location: Sector-135 Noida

Experience Required: 2+ Years

Employment Type: Full-time

About the Role:

We are seeking a detail-oriented and experienced Accountant with 4 years of proven expertise in financial reporting, accounting operations, and compliance. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing day-to-day accounting tasks, ensuring accuracy in financial records, and supporting the organization in achieving its financial goals.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Manage and oversee daily accounting operations, including accounts payable, accounts receivable, general ledger, and bank reconciliations.
  • Prepare accurate financial statements, balance sheets, profit & loss statements, and other reports.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards, tax laws, and company policies.
  • Handle monthly, quarterly, and annual closing processes.
  • Maintain and reconcile fixed assets register.
  • Coordinate with auditors for statutory and internal audits.
  • Assist in budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning activities.
  • Review and process expense reports and reimbursements.
  • Identify process improvement opportunities and implement best practices.

Required Qualifications & Skills:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field.
  • Minimum 4 years of accounting experience.
  • Strong knowledge of accounting principles (GAAP/IFRS).
  • Proficiency in accounting software (e.g., Tally, QuickBooks, SAP) and MS Excel.
  • Excellent analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Good communication skills for coordination with internal and external stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in [Industry Type, e.g., IT services, manufacturing, etc.].
  • Knowledge of GST, TDS, and other statutory compliance in India.
  • Professional certification (e.g., CA Inter, CMA, CPA) will be an advantage.

Salary & Benefits:

  • Competitive salary based on experience.
  • Health insurance, paid leaves, and other company benefits.
  • Opportunities for career growth and professional development.

recruiter: Mrs Piyushi Soni HR Manager

profile.description: Company Description Welcome to CES Tech, where innovation meets reliability, and technology becomes a catalyst for success. Our journey began in 2015, fuelled by a passion for revolutionizing IT infrastructure support. As a team of dedicated professionals, we embarked on a mission to empower businesses through robust and cutting-edge IT solutions. We are seeking a skilled and proactive Network Engineer to join our IT team. As a Network Engineer, you will be responsible for maintaining, troubleshooting, and optimizing our network infrastructure. This role serves as an escalation point for Level 1 support and works closely with senior engineers to ensure high availability, performance, and security of the network. Key Responsibilities: Provide second-level support for network incidents, service requests, and escalations from L1 support teams. Monitor network performance using tools like SolarWinds, PRTG, or Nagios. Troubleshoot issues with routers, switches, firewalls, wireless access points, and other networking hardware. Configure and maintain network devices (Cisco, Juniper, HP, etc.). Implement network changes, patches, and upgrades following change management procedures. Assist in managing VPNs, VLANs, routing protocols (EIGRP, OSPF, BGP), and firewall rules. Perform routine audits of systems and software. Work with vendors and service providers to resolve hardware/software issues. Document network configurations, changes, and procedures. Participate in on-call rotation and after-hours support as needed. Technical Skills: Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, LAN/WAN, VPN. Experience with Cisco or Juniper routers/switches. Familiarity with firewall platforms (e.g., Cisco ASA, Palo Alto, Fortinet). Basic understanding of wireless technologies and VoIP systems. Experience with network monitoring and ticketing systems.

description_html:
Company Description


Welcome to CES Tech, where innovation meets reliability, and technology becomes a catalyst for success. Our journey began in 2015, fuelled by a passion for revolutionizing IT infrastructure support. As a team of dedicated professionals, we embarked on a mission to empower businesses through robust and cutting-edge IT solutions.

 

We are seeking a skilled and proactive Network Engineer to join our IT team. As a Network Engineer, you will be responsible for maintaining, troubleshooting, and optimizing our network infrastructure. This role serves as an escalation point for Level 1 support and works closely with senior engineers to ensure high availability, performance, and security of the network.

 

Key Responsibilities:

  • Provide second-level support for network incidents, service requests, and escalations from L1 support teams.
  • Monitor network performance using tools like SolarWinds, PRTG, or Nagios.
  • Troubleshoot issues with routers, switches, firewalls, wireless access points, and other networking hardware.
  • Configure and maintain network devices (Cisco, Juniper, HP, etc.).
  • Implement network changes, patches, and upgrades following change management procedures.
  • Assist in managing VPNs, VLANs, routing protocols (EIGRP, OSPF, BGP), and firewall rules.
  • Perform routine audits of systems and software.
  • Work with vendors and service providers to resolve hardware/software issues.
  • Document network configurations, changes, and procedures.
  • Participate in on-call rotation and after-hours support as needed.

 

Technical Skills:

  • Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, LAN/WAN, VPN.
  • Experience with Cisco or Juniper routers/switches.
  • Familiarity with firewall platforms (e.g., Cisco ASA, Palo Alto, Fortinet).
  • Basic understanding of wireless technologies and VoIP systems.
  • Experience with network monitoring and ticketing systems.

description: Company Description Welcome to CES Tech, where innovation meets reliability, and technology becomes a catalyst for success. Our journey began in 2015, fuelled by a passion for revolutionizing IT infrastructure support. As a team of dedicated professionals, we embarked on a mission to empower businesses through robust and cutting-edge IT solutions. We are seeking a skilled and proactive Network Engineer to join our IT team. As a Network Engineer, you will be responsible for maintaining, troubleshooting, and optimizing our network infrastructure. This role serves as an escalation point for Level 1 support and works closely with senior engineers to ensure high availability, performance, and security of the network. Key Responsibilities: Provide second-level support for network incidents, service requests, and escalations from L1 support teams. Monitor network performance using tools like SolarWinds, PRTG, or Nagios. Troubleshoot issues with routers, switches, firewalls, wireless access points, and other networking hardware. Configure and maintain network devices (Cisco, Juniper, HP, etc.). Implement network changes, patches, and upgrades following change management procedures. Assist in managing VPNs, VLANs, routing protocols (EIGRP, OSPF, BGP), and firewall rules. Perform routine audits of systems and software. Work with vendors and service providers to resolve hardware/software issues. Document network configurations, changes, and procedures. Participate in on-call rotation and after-hours support as needed. Technical Skills: Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, LAN/WAN, VPN. Experience with Cisco or Juniper routers/switches. Familiarity with firewall platforms (e.g., Cisco ASA, Palo Alto, Fortinet). Basic understanding of wireless technologies and VoIP systems. Experience with network monitoring and ticketing systems.

description_html:
Job Title: Project Coordinator – IT Networking Services

Employment Type: Full-time

About the Role:

We are seeking a proactive and detail-oriented Project Coordinator to join our IT Networking Services team specializing in Edge Technology. The ideal candidate will work closely with project managers, network engineers, and clients to ensure smooth project execution, timely delivery, and quality outcomes for cutting-edge networking solutions.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Coordinate and support IT networking projects with a focus on Edge Computing, SD-WAN, IoT, and Cloud Integration.
  • Assist the Project Manager in planning, scheduling, and tracking project milestones.
  • Manage project documentation, including SOWs, project plans, meeting minutes, and status reports.
  • Act as the primary liaison between internal teams, vendors, and clients to ensure clear communication.
  • Monitor project progress, identify risks, and escalate issues when needed.
  • Ensure adherence to project timelines, budgets, and quality standards.
  • Coordinate with network engineers for deployment, testing, and troubleshooting activities.
  • Support post-implementation reviews and project closure activities.
  • Maintain compliance with IT security policies and data protection standards.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, Electronics, or related field.
  • 2–4 years of experience in IT project coordination, preferably in networking services.
  • Knowledge of networking fundamentals (LAN/WAN, routing, switching, firewalls, VPNs).
  • Familiarity with Edge Computing, SD-WAN, and IoT solutions is highly desirable.
  • Strong organizational and multitasking skills.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.
  • Proficiency in MS Project, Jira, Trello, or other project management tools.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.

Key Competencies:

  • Detail-oriented and proactive approach.
  • Strong problem-solving abilities.
  • Collaborative team player with leadership potential.

Benefits:

  • Competitive salary and performance incentives.
  • Learning and certification support.
  • Exposure to emerging networking and edge technologies.
  • Health and wellness programs.

description_html:
Job Title: Senior Network Engineer – Cisco ACI Specialist

Experience: Minimum 5 years in the IT Networking Industry

Location: Sector-135 Noida

Job Summary:

We are seeking an experienced Senior Network Engineer with strong expertise in Cisco ACI to design, implement, and maintain advanced network infrastructures. The ideal candidate will have deep technical knowledge of ACI fabric, SD-WAN, Cisco NX-OS, and integration of security & service appliances within ACI deployments.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, implement, and maintain Cisco ACI fabric, including APIC, Spine, and Leaf components.
  • Configure and manage Tenants, VRFs, EPGs, Contracts, and L3Out in Cisco ACI.
  • Manage and troubleshoot SD-WAN solutions (Cisco Viptela or Meraki preferred).
  • Operate and maintain Cisco NX-OS platforms (Nexus 9K/7K/5K series).
  • Integrate firewalls, load balancers, and other service appliances into ACI environments.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams for network planning, capacity, and security.
  • Document network architecture, configurations, and operational procedures.
  • Perform proactive network monitoring, troubleshooting, and optimization.

Required Skills & Qualifications:

  • Minimum 5 years of relevant industry experience in network engineering.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Cisco ACI (fabric, policies, L3Out).
  • Proficient in Cisco SD-WAN solutions (Viptela / Meraki preferred).
  • Expertise in Cisco NX-OS for Nexus switches (9K/7K/5K series).
  • Ability to integrate third-party appliances (firewalls, load balancers) into ACI.
  • Excellent troubleshooting skills across Layer 2–7.
  • Strong documentation and communication skills.
  • Relevant certifications preferred (CCNP/CCIE – Data Center or Enterprise).

Preferred Skills:

  • Familiarity with automation tools (Python, Ansible) for network operations.
  • Knowledge of ITIL processes for incident, problem, and change management.
  • Experience with multi-tenant environments and security segmentation.

description: Job Title: Senior Network Engineer – Cisco ACI Specialist Experience: Minimum 5 years in the IT Networking Industry Location: Sector-135 Noida Job Summary: We are seeking an experienced Senior Network Engineer with strong expertise in Cisco ACI to design, implement, and maintain advanced network infrastructures. The ideal candidate will have deep technical knowledge of ACI fabric, SD-WAN, Cisco NX-OS, and integration of security & service appliances within ACI deployments. Key Responsibilities: Design, implement, and maintain Cisco ACI fabric, including APIC, Spine, and Leaf components. Configure and manage Tenants, VRFs, EPGs, Contracts, and L3Out in Cisco ACI. Manage and troubleshoot SD-WAN solutions (Cisco Viptela or Meraki preferred). Operate and maintain Cisco NX-OS platforms (Nexus 9K/7K/5K series). Integrate firewalls, load balancers, and other service appliances into ACI environments. Collaborate with cross-functional teams for network planning, capacity, and security. Document network architecture, configurations, and operational procedures. Perform proactive network monitoring, troubleshooting, and optimization. Required Skills & Qualifications: Minimum 5 years of relevant industry experience in network engineering. Strong hands-on experience with Cisco ACI (fabric, policies, L3Out). Proficient in Cisco SD-WAN solutions (Viptela / Meraki preferred). Expertise in Cisco NX-OS for Nexus switches (9K/7K/5K series). Ability to integrate third-party appliances (firewalls, load balancers) into ACI. Excellent troubleshooting skills across Layer 2–7. Strong documentation and communication skills. Relevant certifications preferred (CCNP/CCIE – Data Center or Enterprise). Preferred Skills: Familiarity with automation tools (Python, Ansible) for network operations. Knowledge of ITIL processes for incident, problem, and change management. Experience with multi-tenant environments and security segmentation.

description_html:
Job Title: L2 Network & Security Engineer – Implementation Specialist

Experience: 5+ years in Networking & Security Implementation

Location: CES Tech | Sector-135 Noida


Job Summary:

We are looking for an experienced L2 Network & Security Engineer to deliver implementation services for enterprise-grade network and security solutions. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in configuring, deploying, and troubleshooting Cisco, Palo Alto, Check Point, Juniper, and Fortinet technologies.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement, configure, and optimize network and security solutions for enterprise clients.
  • Deploy and integrate firewalls, routers, switches, and security appliances from vendors such as Cisco, Palo Alto, Check Point, Juniper, and Fortinet.
  • Conduct L2-level troubleshooting and issue resolution for network and security incidents.
  • Perform routing and switching configurations (OSPF, BGP, VLANs, ACLs, NAT, VPNs).
  • Assist in migrating and upgrading network/security infrastructures.
  • Work with senior engineers to design secure, high-availability architectures.
  • Maintain and update documentation of configurations, network diagrams, and change logs.
  • Ensure security best practices and compliance during deployments.

Required Skills & Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of relevant experience in network and security implementation.
  • Hands-on experience with:
  • Cisco (Routers, Switches, ASA/FTD Firewalls)
  • Palo Alto Networks (NGFW, Panorama)
  • Check Point (Firewall, SmartConsole)
  • Juniper (SRX, EX series)
  • Fortinet (FortiGate, FortiManager
  • Strong understanding of network protocols (TCP/IP, OSPF, BGP, VLANs, VPNs).
  • Ability to work independently and in a team environment.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills for L2/L3 network & security issues.
  • Good communication and documentation skills.
  • Relevant certifications preferred (CCNP Security, PCNSE, JNCIS-SEC, NSE4).

Preferred Skills:

  • Knowledge of SD-WAN and cloud security integrations.
  • Experience with network automation tools (Python, Ansible).
  • Familiarity with ITIL processes for incident, change, and problem management.

candidates.cover_letter: Dear Hiring Manager, I am writing to express my strong interest in the Senior Network Administrator / Network Security Engineer role at your organisation. With approximately 3 years of hands-on experience in enterprise network operations, F5 load balancing and WAF management, firewall administration, and ITSM-driven incident handling, I am confident in my ability to contribute meaningfully to your infrastructure team from day one. A core strength of mine is my expertise with F5 BIG-IP technologies — specifically LTM (Local Traffic Manager), GTM (Global Traffic Manager), and WAF (Web Application Firewall). In my previous role at Capgemini Technology Services, I was responsible for monitoring and managing servers, pools, and virtual servers on F5 LTM via the F5 GUI, administering GTM for DNS-based global traffic distribution, and enforcing WAF security policies for web application traffic inspection and threat mitigation. I also reviewed iRule configurations and maintained pool member health to ensure maximum service availability. Beyond F5, I bring broad expertise in network security and NOC operations. I have administered Fortigate, Fortimanager, Fortianalyzer, and Check Point firewalls, managed Bluecoat Proxy for URL filtering and policy enforcement, and handled IPAM operations using Netbox and Infoblox. I have actively supported SOC teams by reviewing firewall logs, monitoring SIEM alerts, and coordinating with ISPs and TAC engineers to uphold SLA commitments. My experience spans routing protocols (OSPF, BGP), switching (Cisco ASR, Nexus 7K/9K), and SDN platforms including DNAC and APIC (Cisco ACI). In terms of operational delivery, I supervised a team of 12 engineers and consistently resolved over 1,000+ tickets per month across 12 enterprise clients while maintaining a 100% escalation-free record. I am well-versed in ITSM frameworks, having worked extensively with ServiceNow and BMC Remedy for incident and change management — including handling incidents and changes efficiently to maintain uninterrupted service continuity. I hold a Fortinet Certified Associate in Cybersecurity (2025) and have completed certifications in ITIL 4, AWS Machine Learning, Google Analytics IQ, CCNA fundamentals, SRE, and Windows Server Administration through Pluralsight and Coursera. I hold an MCA (CGPA: 8.0) from BPUT University, providing a solid academic foundation in computer science alongside my practical experience. I am eager to bring my technical depth, operational discipline, and collaborative approach to a dynamic organisation where I can contribute to robust, secure, and high-performing network infrastructure. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my background aligns with your team's goals. Thank you for your time and consideration. I look forward to hearing from you. Warm regards, Keshav Kumar Jha Senior Network Administrator | F5 LTM / GTM / WAF | Network Security +91 7008536491 | ultraking69@gmail.com

title_raw: L2 Network & Security Engineer – Implementation Specialist
description: Job Title: L2 Network & Security Engineer – Implementation Specialist Experience: 5+ years in Networking & Security Implementation Location: CES Tech | Sector-135 Noida Job Summary: We are looking for an experienced L2 Network & Security Engineer to deliver implementation services for enterprise-grade network and security solutions. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in configuring, deploying, and troubleshooting Cisco, Palo Alto, Check Point, Juniper, and Fortinet technologies. Key Responsibilities: Implement, configure, and optimize network and security solutions for enterprise clients. Deploy and integrate firewalls, routers, switches, and security appliances from vendors such as Cisco, Palo Alto, Check Point, Juniper, and Fortinet. Conduct L2-level troubleshooting and issue resolution for network and security incidents. Perform routing and switching configurations (OSPF, BGP, VLANs, ACLs, NAT, VPNs). Assist in migrating and upgrading network/security infrastructures. Work with senior engineers to design secure, high-availability architectures. Maintain and update documentation of configurations, network diagrams, and change logs. Ensure security best practices and compliance during deployments. Required Skills & Qualifications: 5+ years of relevant experience in network and security implementation. Hands-on experience with: Cisco (Routers, Switches, ASA/FTD Firewalls) Palo Alto Networks (NGFW, Panorama) Check Point (Firewall, SmartConsole) Juniper (SRX, EX series) Fortinet (FortiGate, FortiManager Strong understanding of network protocols (TCP/IP, OSPF, BGP, VLANs, VPNs). Ability to work independently and in a team environment. Strong troubleshooting skills for L2/L3 network & security issues. Good communication and documentation skills. Relevant certifications preferred (CCNP Security, PCNSE, JNCIS-SEC, NSE4). Preferred Skills: Knowledge of SD-WAN and cloud security integrations. Experience with network automation tools (Python, Ansible). Familiarity with ITIL processes for incident, change, and problem management.

Maintain the highest level of technical competency within the organization.

description_html:
Overview

We are seeking an experienced and visionary Technical Solution Architect to lead and manage our entire technical services delivery organization. This critical leadership role is responsible for overseeing the pre-sales, professional services, post-sales support, and technical training functions. The Director will drive operational excellence, ensure the successful delivery of complex IT infrastructure projects, and maintain strong technical partnerships with our key Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs) like Cisco, Fortinet, Palo Alto Networks, and Check Point. The ideal candidate is a strategic leader with deep technical expertise in modern networking, security, and data center technologies.

Key Responsibilities

 

1. Technical Leadership & Strategy

  • Define and execute the technical services strategy, ensuring alignment with overall business goals and growth objectives.
  • Maintain expert-level knowledge of the latest industry trends and our core technologies, including:
  • Networking: Cisco SD-WAN, Cisco ACI, Cisco Data Center Networks.
  • Security: Next-Generation Firewalls (Palo Alto, FortiGate, Check Point), Zero Trust Architecture.
  • Compute: Server and Storage technologies.
  • Serve as the highest point of technical escalation for complex project issues and client challenges.

2. Service Delivery & Operations

  • Oversee all technical service delivery functions, including project management, implementation, system integration, and support.
  • Develop, implement, and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and service level agreements (SLAs) for the technical team to ensure high quality and timely delivery.
  • Optimize resource allocation and scheduling to maximize utilization and profitability across all projects.
  • Drive process standardization and continuous improvement in service methodologies and documentation.

3. Team Management & Development

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of Technical Consultants, Engineers, and Architects.
  • Manage recruitment, training, and performance reviews for the entire technical services staff.
  • Foster a culture of technical excellence, accountability, and continuous learning regarding OEM products and certifications.

4. Pre-Sales and Client Engagement

  • Partner with the Sales team to provide technical expertise during the pre-sales process, including scoping, effort estimation, and presenting complex solutions to clients.
  • Act as a senior technical trusted advisor for key clients, building and maintaining strong relationships.

5. OEM & Vendor Management

  • Manage technical relationships with core OEMs (Cisco, Fortinet, Palo Alto, Check Point, etc.) to ensure access to the latest roadmaps, training, and support resources.
  • Drive the team to achieve and maintain required partner certifications and specializations.

 

Required Qualifications & Experience

 

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in IT services, with at least 5 years in a senior leadership or directorial role managing technical teams in a System Integrator or Managed Services Provider (MSP) environment.
  • Deep technical expertise and hands-on knowledge in multiple areas:
  • Cisco Enterprise Networking (e.g., SD-WAN, Catalyst/Nexus switches).
  • Cisco Data Center (e.g., ACI, UCS/Hyperflex is a plus).
  • Security Architecture (with proficiency in technologies from Fortinet, Palo Alto Networks, and/or Check Point).
  • Proven ability to strategically plan, develop, and implement professional services methodologies.
  • Exceptional leadership, communication, and client-facing skills.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field (Master’s degree preferred).
  • Relevant industry certifications (e.g., CCNP/CCIE, Fortinet NSE, PCNSE, CISSP, ITIL) are highly desirable.

 

Success Factors

The successful Technical Services Director will be defined by their ability to:

  • Consistently achieve high client satisfaction and technical service delivery quality.
  • Effectively scale the technical team and services to support business growth.
  • Drive profitability and efficiency in project delivery and support operations.
  • Maintain the highest level of technical competency within the organization.

description: Overview We are seeking an experienced and visionary Technical Solution Architect to lead and manage our entire technical services delivery organization. This critical leadership role is responsible for overseeing the pre-sales, professional services, post-sales support, and technical training functions. The Director will drive operational excellence, ensure the successful delivery of complex IT infrastructure projects, and maintain strong technical partnerships with our key Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs) like Cisco, Fortinet, Palo Alto Networks, and Check Point. The ideal candidate is a strategic leader with deep technical expertise in modern networking, security, and data center technologies. Key Responsibilities 1. Technical Leadership & Strategy Define and execute the technical services strategy, ensuring alignment with overall business goals and growth objectives. Maintain expert-level knowledge of the latest industry trends and our core technologies, including: Networking: Cisco SD-WAN, Cisco ACI, Cisco Data Center Networks. Security: Next-Generation Firewalls (Palo Alto, FortiGate, Check Point), Zero Trust Architecture. Compute: Server and Storage technologies. Serve as the highest point of technical escalation for complex project issues and client challenges. 2. Service Delivery & Operations Oversee all technical service delivery functions, including project management, implementation, system integration, and support. Develop, implement, and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and service level agreements (SLAs) for the technical team to ensure high quality and timely delivery. Optimize resource allocation and scheduling to maximize utilization and profitability across all projects. Drive process standardization and continuous improvement in service methodologies and documentation. 3. Team Management & Development Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of Technical Consultants, Engineers, and Architects. Manage recruitment, training, and performance reviews for the entire technical services staff. Foster a culture of technical excellence, accountability, and continuous learning regarding OEM products and certifications. 4. Pre-Sales and Client Engagement Partner with the Sales team to provide technical expertise during the pre-sales process, including scoping, effort estimation, and presenting complex solutions to clients. Act as a senior technical trusted advisor for key clients, building and maintaining strong relationships. 5. OEM & Vendor Management Manage technical relationships with core OEMs (Cisco, Fortinet, Palo Alto, Check Point, etc.) to ensure access to the latest roadmaps, training, and support resources. Drive the team to achieve and maintain required partner certifications and specializations. Required Qualifications & Experience 10+ years of progressive experience in IT services, with at least 5 years in a senior leadership or directorial role managing technical teams in a System Integrator or Managed Services Provider (MSP) environment. Deep technical expertise and hands-on knowledge in multiple areas: Cisco Enterprise Networking (e.g., SD-WAN, Catalyst/Nexus switches). Cisco Data Center (e.g., ACI, UCS/Hyperflex is a plus). Security Architecture (with proficiency in technologies from Fortinet, Palo Alto Networks, and/or Check Point). Proven ability to strategically plan, develop, and implement professional services methodologies. Exceptional leadership, communication, and client-facing skills. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field (Master’s degree preferred). Relevant industry certifications (e.g., CCNP/CCIE, Fortinet NSE, PCNSE, CISSP, ITIL) are highly desirable. Success Factors The successful Technical Services Director will be defined by their ability to: Consistently achieve high client satisfaction and technical service delivery quality. Effectively scale the technical team and services to support business growth. Drive profitability and efficiency in project delivery and support operations. Maintain the highest level of technical competency within the organization.

description_html:
Resident Engineer/ Network Engineer

System Integrator Partner | Mussoorie, Uttarakhand | On-site | Full-time

Industry: Government / ICT Infrastructure | Domain: Wi-Fi Campus Network

About the Role

We are looking for a skilled Resident Engineer to manage, operate, and maintain the Wi-Fi campus network at Mussoorie Location. You will be the single point of accountability for day-to-day network health, coordinating with site officials, System Integrators, and OEMs to ensure seamless connectivity across the campus.

Key Responsibilities

  • Operate, configure, monitor, and maintain campus network infrastructure including Core Switch, Distribution & Access Switches, Wireless Access Points, WLC, NAC, EMS, RADIUS Server, and NGFW.
  • Perform proactive monitoring, fault analysis, and timely resolution to maintain agreed SLA uptime targets.
  • Log and track all complaints raised with the System Integrator; maintain detailed call-log, uptime/downtime, and resolution records
  • ⁠Prepare and submit regular network performance and functionality reports to per requirements.
  • ⁠Provide handholding and training on network operations, day-to-day management, and first-level troubleshooting.
  • ⁠Coordinate with site officials, System Integrators, and OEMs for smooth operations and problem resolution.
  • ⁠Handle any other ICT-related work assigned by the end user.

Qualifications & Experience

Education

  • 3-year Diploma or 4-year Graduate Engineering in Electronics, Communication, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related stream.

Experience

  • Minimum 4 years of industry experience (for Diploma holders) or 3 years (for Graduate Engineers) in Networking / Communication / ICT.
  • ⁠Minimum 2 years of experience managing and maintaining LAN, WAN, and Wi-Fi campus networks.
  • ⁠Minimum 1 year of hands-on experience configuring and managing Routers, L2/L3 Switches, Wireless Access Points, WLC, NAC, EMS, and NGFW.
  • ⁠Formal training or certification in Computer Networking (CCNA / equivalent preferred).
  • ⁠Demonstrated ability to prepare structured reports on network functionality and performance.
  • ⁠Strong written and verbal communication skills in Hindi and English.

Good to Have

  • Experience on government or campus network projects under NIC frameworks.
  • ⁠Familiarity with RADIUS, AAA, 802.1X authentication, and network access control.
  • ⁠Exposure to EMS dashboards and SLA-based maintenance contracts.

Work & Engagement Details

  • Working Hours
  • 48 hrs/week (6 days) Leave Policy
  • 2 Earned Leaves/month
  • Shift
  • Round the clock incl. holidays Location
  • Mussoorie, Uttarakhand

Note: Working hours, timings, and leave decisions are subject to the end user / ERNET India guidelines. Flexible shift working including holidays and festivals may be required as per site requirements.

Why Join Us

  • Work on a high-visibility, large-scale national ICT infrastructure project.
  • ⁠Collaborate directly with Client and leading OEMs in the enterprise networking space.
  • ⁠Opportunity to upskill across enterprise networking, wireless technologies, and network management platforms.
  • ⁠Stable, long-term engagement backed by a government tender framework.

description_html:
Job Title

IT Infrastructure Technical Project Manager

Location

Noida — Sector 135 (Assotech / CES Tech office, Tech-Park campus)

About the Company / Workplace Environment

The office is based in a modern IT/ITES campus in Noida’s Sector 135 — part of a grade-A tech-park complex with modern infrastructure, good connectivity, and a workplace environment suited for large-scale IT operations.

Role Overview

As an IT Infrastructure Project Manager, you will lead and deliver infrastructure-related projects for CES Tech — overseeing planning, execution, deployment, and maintenance for company’s IT infrastructure. You will coordinate with internal teams, vendors, and stakeholders to ensure that projects are completed on time, within scope and budget, and meet the company’s quality and security standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define project scope, objectives, deliverables, timelines, and resource requirements for infrastructure projects (servers, network, storage, cloud, data-center/DR, security, upgrades).
  • Plan and manage end-to-end project lifecycle: initiation, planning, execution, monitoring, closure.
  • Coordinate with internal IT teams, external vendors/contractors, and other stakeholders.
  • Ensure procurement and deployment of required hardware/software/infrastructure components — manage vendor contracts and relationships.
  • Monitor progress, track milestones, dependencies, and deliverables; report status to senior leadership.
  • Identify, assess and mitigate project risks; manage issues, escalations, and changes.
  • Ensure compliance with company’s IT policies, infrastructure standards, security protocols.
  • Maintain documentation: project plans, high-level/low-level design reviews (HLD/LLD), configuration documents, deployment plans, SOPs, change logs, status reports.
  • Oversee handover, post-deployment support, and ensure smooth operations after project completion.
  • Facilitate coordination for any required audits, security reviews, or compliance checks.


Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or related discipline (or equivalent).
  • 5–10 years of experience in IT infrastructure projects (servers, networking, cloud, data center, etc.) — ideally including project management responsibility.
  • Strong knowledge of enterprise-level infrastructure: networking, virtualization, storage, cloud (on-prem and/or public), security, DR/backup practices.
  • Proven experience managing projects end-to-end, including vendor coordination and procurement.
  • Familiarity with project management tools and documentation: scheduling, task tracking, design documents, reports.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management — ability to coordinate internal teams and external vendors.
  • Strong planning, risk-management, problem-solving and decision-making skills.
  • Commitment to quality, compliance, and security best practices.
  • Flexibility to handle multiple concurrent infrastructure projects, possibly under tight deadlines.


Preferred Additional Qualifications

  • Certifications such as PMP / PRINCE2 / ITIL or relevant cloud certifications.
  • Experience working in IT/ITES campus-style environment or large corporate infrastructure.
  • Prior experience with vendor management, contracts, procurement, and coordination of third-party services.


Personal & Behavioural Attributes

  • Strong ownership, accountability, and commitment to delivery.
  • Good leadership and team-coordinating ability.
  • Excellent organizational, time-management and prioritization skills.
  • Calm under pressure, with ability to handle multiple tasks and tight deadlines.
  • Collaborative mindset — works well with cross-functional teams and external partners/vendors.

We don't need you to be a security expert yet, but we need you to be a product builder who can master complex data and turn it into a clean, beautiful user experience. The Brain: Integrations with LLMs (Claude/Llama) to analyze threats and filter false positives. Who You Are Full Stack Native: You are comfortable jumping between a React frontend and a Python backend in the same hour. AI Enthusiast: You’ve played with LangChain, CrewAI, or local LLMs and understand "RAG" and "Prompt Engineering." Data-Driven: You know how to design databases (Postgres/Supabase) that can handle complex relationships. Technical Wishlist (The "Perfect" Fit): Languages: Python (FastAPI/Django), TypeScript (React/Next.js). AI Stack: LangChain, Ollama, Vector Databases (Pinecone/Chroma). Bonus: Familiarity with Networking (Nmap, TCP/IP) or Security tools. Why This Role?This is not a "maintain legacy code" job. description_html:
Job Title: Senior Full Stack Engineer (AI & Cybersecurity Product)

The Mission We are looking for a key engineer to lead the development of an AI-powered Security Analyst. Imagine a tool that scans critical infrastructure (IT & OT), identifies risks like a human expert, and automatically drafts the fix. That’s what you’ll be building.

We don't need you to be a security expert yet, but we need you to be a product builder who can master complex data and turn it into a clean, beautiful user experience.

What You'll Build

  • The Core: A scalable backend (Python) that orchestrates network scanners and AI agents.
  • The Brain: Integrations with LLMs (Claude/Llama) to analyze threats and filter false positives.
  • The Face: A high-performance dashboard (React/Next.js) that visualizes network health and real-time attacks.

Who You Are

  • Full Stack Native: You are comfortable jumping between a React frontend and a Python backend in the same hour.
  • AI Enthusiast: You’ve played with LangChain, CrewAI, or local LLMs and understand "RAG" and "Prompt Engineering."
  • Data-Driven: You know how to design databases (Postgres/Supabase) that can handle complex relationships.

Technical Wishlist (The "Perfect" Fit):

  • Languages: Python (FastAPI/Django), TypeScript (React/Next.js).
  • AI Stack: LangChain, Ollama, Vector Databases (Pinecone/Chroma).
  • Bonus: Familiarity with Networking (Nmap, TCP/IP) or Security tools.

Why This Role?This is not a "maintain legacy code" job. This is a Founding Engineer role where your architectural decisions will shape the product for years. You will work directly with the founder to bring a game-changing security tool to market.

📩 Apply Now: hr@ces-pl.com

I have a strong foundation in full-stack development and a growing interest in building secure, intelligent, and scalable systems. I have worked on multiple full-stack projects where I handled both frontend and backend development, including authentication, role-based access, secure APIs, and payment integrations. One of my key projects, Eventix, involved designing a complete event booking platform with admin dashboards, payment workflows, and security best practices. These experiences have helped me understand real-world system design, performance, and reliability. What excites me about this role is the opportunity to work at the intersection of engineering, AI, and security. I enjoy learning how systems behave at scale and how security considerations influence architecture and product decisions. I am eager to contribute, learn from experienced engineers, and grow into building robust AI-driven products. I bring a strong problem-solving mindset, clean coding practices, and the willingness to take ownership of features end-to-end. I am confident that my technical foundation and learning attitude would allow me to add value to your team. Thank you for considering my application. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to your engineering goals. Kind regards, Sakshee

Sales Associate (Fresher)

description_html:
Job Title: IT Recruiter

Experience Required: 6 Months – 1 Year

Location: Sector-135, Noida

Employment Type: Full-Time (General Shift)

Industry: IT Services / Networking / Technology

Job Summary

We are looking for an enthusiastic and detail-oriented IT Recruitee with 6 months to 1 year of experience to support our recruitment and hiring activities. The ideal candidate will assist in sourcing candidates, coordinating interviews, maintaining candidate databases, and ensuring smooth communication between candidates and the internal hiring team.

This role requires strong communication skills, organizational abilities, and the capability to manage multiple candidate interactions simultaneously.

Key Responsibilities

1. Candidate Sourcing & Screening

  • Source candidates from job portals such as Naukri, LinkedIn, Indeed, and other recruitment platforms
  • Review resumes and shortlist candidates based on job requirements
  • Conduct initial screening calls to assess candidate suitability

2. Interview Coordination

  • Schedule interviews between candidates and hiring managers
  • Coordinate interview availability and confirm interview timings
  • Send interview invitations and reminders to candidates

3. Candidate Communication

  • Maintain regular communication with candidates throughout the recruitment process
  • Provide updates regarding interview status, feedback, and next steps
  • Handle candidate queries related to job roles and interview schedules

4. Database & Record Management

  • Maintain candidate information in Excel trackers or recruitment systems
  • Update interview status, feedback, and hiring progress regularly
  • Maintain organized records of resumes, interview notes, and candidate documents

5. Recruitment Support

  • Assist HR team in managing recruitment activities
  • Help prepare job postings and share openings on job portals and social media
  • Support onboarding documentation after candidate selection


Requirements

  • 6 months – 1 year of experience in recruitment, HR coordination, or talent acquisition
  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field (preferred)
  • Good verbal and written communication skills
  • Basic knowledge of MS Excel, MS Word, and recruitment tracking
  • Ability to manage multiple candidates and interview schedules
  • Strong organizational and follow-up skills
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment


Preferred Skills

  • Experience in IT recruitment or technical hiring
  • Familiarity with job portals and LinkedIn sourcing
  • Strong candidate coordination and follow-up ability

What We Offer

  • Opportunity to work in a growing IT services company
  • Hands-on experience in technical recruitment and talent acquisition
  • Learning and career growth opportunities in HR and recruitment
  • Supportive and collaborative team environment

description_html:
Job Title: Data Center Technical Lead (Service Delivery & Architecture)


Overview

We are seeking a highly experienced and strategic Data Center Technical Lead to drive and oversee end-to-end technical service delivery across our organization. This leadership role is accountable for managing pre-sales engineering, professional services delivery, post-sales support, and technical capability development.

The ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in modern data center, networking, and cybersecurity technologies, along with proven leadership experience in System Integrator (SI) or Managed Services Provider (MSP) environments. This role requires a balance of deep technical knowledge, operational excellence, and client-facing leadership.

Key Responsibilities


1. Technical Leadership & Strategy

  • Define and execute the technical services roadmap aligned with business growth and organizational objectives.
  • Act as the primary technical authority for complex infrastructure and security solutions.
  • Maintain deep expertise across core technology domains:
  • Networking: Cisco SD-WAN, Cisco ACI, Enterprise & Data Center Networks
  • Security: Next-Generation Firewalls (Palo Alto, Fortinet, Check Point), Zero Trust Architecture
  • Compute & Storage: Enterprise server, virtualization, and storage platforms
  • Provide technical governance, solution validation, and escalation support for critical customer engagements.

2. Service Delivery & Operations

  • Lead end-to-end delivery of technical services including implementation, integration, and managed support.
  • Establish and monitor KPIs and SLAs to ensure consistent, high-quality service delivery.
  • Drive operational efficiency through resource planning, utilization optimization, and delivery governance.
  • Standardize processes, frameworks, and documentation to ensure scalability and repeatability.
  • Ensure successful delivery of complex, multi-technology IT infrastructure projects within timelines and budgets.

3. Team Leadership & Capability Development

  • Build, lead, and mentor a high-performing team of engineers, consultants, and solution architects.
  • Oversee hiring, onboarding, performance management, and career development of technical teams.
  • Promote a culture of continuous learning, certification, and technical excellence.
  • Develop structured training programs aligned with OEM technologies and business needs.

4. Pre-Sales & Client Engagement

  • Collaborate closely with Sales teams to support solution design, effort estimation, and proposal development.
  • Present and articulate complex technical solutions to enterprise customers and stakeholders.
  • Act as a trusted technical advisor for key clients, ensuring long-term relationship development and customer satisfaction.

5. OEM & Vendor Management

  • Manage strategic technical partnerships with key OEMs such as Cisco, Fortinet, Palo Alto Networks, and Check Point.
  • Ensure alignment with OEM roadmaps, product updates, and support structures.
  • Drive partner certifications, accreditations, and specializations to maintain competitive positioning.


Required Qualifications & Experience

  • Experience:
  • 15+ years in IT infrastructure/services, with at least 10 years in a leadership role within SI/MSP environments.
  • Technical Expertise:
  • Strong hands-on experience in:
  • Cisco Enterprise Networking (SD-WAN, Catalyst, Nexus)
  • Cisco Data Center (ACI, UCS, HyperFlex – preferred)
  • Security technologies (Fortinet, Palo Alto Networks, Check Point)
  • Solid understanding of data center architecture, virtualization, and cloud integration.
  • Leadership & Skills:
  • Proven ability to lead large technical teams and manage cross-functional delivery.
  • Strong communication, stakeholder management, and client engagement skills.
  • Experience in building scalable service delivery models and frameworks.
  • Education:
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or related field
  • Master’s degree (preferred)
  • Certifications (Highly Preferred):
  • CCNP / CCIE
  • Fortinet NSE
  • PCNSE
  • CISSP
  • ITIL

Key Competencies

  • Strategic Thinking & Execution
  • Technical Depth with Business Acumen
  • Customer-Centric Approach
  • Leadership & Team Development
  • Operational Excellence

Job Title: L1 Network Support Engineer

Experience: 2–5 Years

Location: CES Tech | Sector-135, Noida

Job Summary

We are seeking a proactive and detail-oriented L1 Network Support Engineer to provide first-level technical support for enterprise network and security environments. The role involves monitoring, basic troubleshooting, and initial incident resolution across network infrastructure, while ensuring timely escalation to higher support levels when required.

The ideal candidate should have foundational knowledge of networking concepts and a willingness to learn and grow in a fast-paced IT services environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide Level 1 support for network and security-related incidents, service requests, and alerts.
  • Monitor network devices and infrastructure using monitoring tools and dashboards.
  • Perform initial troubleshooting for routers, switches, firewalls, and connectivity issues.
  • Log, track, and update incidents in ticketing systems as per defined SLAs.
  • Escalate complex issues to L2/L3 engineers with proper analysis and documentation.
  • Assist in basic configuration tasks under supervision (VLAN changes, port configurations, access policies, etc.).
  • Support routine activities such as health checks, backups, and patch verification.
  • Maintain accurate documentation of incidents, resolutions, and standard operating procedures (SOPs).
  • Follow ITIL-based processes for incident, problem, and change management.
  • Ensure adherence to organizational security policies and compliance standards.


﻿Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Experience: 0–2 years of experience in network support (freshers with relevant training can also apply).
  • Technical Knowledge:
  • Basic understanding of networking concepts:
  • TCP/IP, OSI Model
  • VLANs, IP Addressing, Subnetting
  • Routing basics (OSPF, Static Routing)
  • Familiarity with network devices such as routers, switches, and firewalls (Cisco preferred).
  • Skills:
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting mindset
  • Good verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to work in a 24x7 support environment (if applicable)
  • Willingness to learn new technologies and tools


Preferred Qualifications

  • Basic exposure to security concepts (Firewall, VPN, NAT).
  • Knowledge of monitoring tools and ticketing systems.
  • Certifications such as CCNA or equivalent (preferred but not mandatory).
  • Understanding of ITIL processes is an added advantage.


Key Competencies

  • Problem Solving & Attention to Detail
  • Customer Focus & Responsiveness
  • Team Collaboration
  • Learning Agility

description_html:
Job Title: L1 Engineer – Cisco ACI (Mumbai)

Experience: Minimum 1.5 years in the IT Networking Industry

Location: Navi Mumbai

Job Summary:

We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented L1 Network Engineer – Cisco ACI to join our network operations team. The candidate will be responsible for providing first-level support for Cisco ACI-based data center environments, monitoring network performance, and assisting in troubleshooting basic network issues.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Monitor and manage Cisco ACI fabric and related network infrastructure
  • Provide L1 support for network incidents, alerts, and service requests
  • Perform basic troubleshooting of ACI components (APIC, Leaf, Spine switches)
  • Escalate complex issues to L2/L3 teams with proper analysis
  • Assist in configuration and provisioning tasks under supervision
  • Monitor network health using tools like Cisco APIC, SNMP, SolarWinds, etc.
  • Maintain daily logs, incident reports, and documentation
  • Support routine maintenance activities and patching schedules
  • Ensure adherence to SLA and response timelines


Required Skills:

  • Basic understanding of Cisco ACI architecture
  • Knowledge of Networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, VLANs, Routing, Switching)
  • Familiarity with data center networking concepts
  • Basic understanding of IP addressing, subnetting, and protocols
  • Hands-on or academic exposure to Cisco technologies is preferred
  • Good troubleshooting and analytical skills
  • Strong communication and documentation skills


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Diploma / B.Tech / B.E. in Computer Science, IT, or related field
  • Certification such as CCNA (preferred but not mandatory)
  • Knowledge of Cisco Nexus switches and virtualization basics is an advantage


Key Competencies:

  • Willingness to learn and grow in ACI and Data Center technologies
  • Ability to work in a 24x7 support environment (shift-based)
  • Team player with a proactive attitude
  • Strong attention to detail


Additional Information:

  • Freshers with relevant training or certification can also apply
  • Opportunity to work on enterprise-level data center and ACI environments

description: Job Title: L1 Engineer – Cisco ACI (Mumbai) Experience: Minimum 1.5 years in the IT Networking Industry Location: Navi Mumbai Job Summary: We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented L1 Network Engineer – Cisco ACI to join our network operations team. The candidate will be responsible for providing first-level support for Cisco ACI-based data center environments, monitoring network performance, and assisting in troubleshooting basic network issues. Key Responsibilities: Monitor and manage Cisco ACI fabric and related network infrastructure Provide L1 support for network incidents, alerts, and service requests Perform basic troubleshooting of ACI components (APIC, Leaf, Spine switches) Escalate complex issues to L2/L3 teams with proper analysis Assist in configuration and provisioning tasks under supervision Monitor network health using tools like Cisco APIC, SNMP, SolarWinds, etc. Maintain daily logs, incident reports, and documentation Support routine maintenance activities and patching schedules Ensure adherence to SLA and response timelines Required Skills: Basic understanding of Cisco ACI architecture Knowledge of Networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, VLANs, Routing, Switching) Familiarity with data center networking concepts Basic understanding of IP addressing, subnetting, and protocols Hands-on or academic exposure to Cisco technologies is preferred Good troubleshooting and analytical skills Strong communication and documentation skills Preferred Qualifications: Diploma / B.Tech / B.E. in Computer Science, IT, or related field Certification such as CCNA (preferred but not mandatory) Knowledge of Cisco Nexus switches and virtualization basics is an advantage Key Competencies: Willingness to learn and grow in ACI and Data Center technologies Ability to work in a 24x7 support environment (shift-based) Team player with a proactive attitude Strong attention to detail Additional Information: Freshers with relevant training or certification can also apply Opportunity to work on enterprise-level data center and ACI environments

description_html:
Job Title: L3 Data Center Engineer – Cisco ACI Specialist

Experience: Minimum 8+ years in the IT Networking Industry

Location: Navi Mumbai / Noida / Kolkatta

Job Summary:

We are seeking an experienced L3 Data Center Engineer – Cisco ACI Specialist with strong expertise in Cisco ACI to design, implement, and maintain advanced network infrastructures. The ideal candidate will have deep technical knowledge of ACI fabric, SD-WAN, Cisco NX-OS, and integration of security & service appliances within ACI deployments.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, implement, and maintain Cisco ACI fabric, including APIC, Spine, and Leaf components.
  • Configure and manage Tenants, VRFs, EPGs, Contracts, and L3Out in Cisco ACI.
  • Manage and troubleshoot SD-WAN solutions (Cisco Viptela or Meraki preferred).
  • Operate and maintain Cisco NX-OS platforms (Nexus 9K/7K/5K series).
  • Integrate firewalls, load balancers, and other service appliances into ACI environments.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams for network planning, capacity, and security.
  • Document network architecture, configurations, and operational procedures.
  • Perform proactive network monitoring, troubleshooting, and optimization.

Required Skills & Qualifications:

  • Minimum 8 years of relevant industry experience in network engineering.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Cisco ACI (fabric, policies, L3Out).
  • Proficient in Cisco SD-WAN solutions (Viptela / Meraki preferred).
  • Expertise in Cisco NX-OS for Nexus switches (9K/7K/5K series).
  • Ability to integrate third-party appliances (firewalls, load balancers) into ACI.
  • Excellent troubleshooting skills across Layer 2–7.
  • Strong documentation and communication skills.
  • Relevant certifications preferred (CCNP/CCIE – Data Center or Enterprise).

Preferred Skills:

  • Familiarity with automation tools (Python, Ansible) for network operations.
  • Knowledge of ITIL processes for incident, problem, and change management.
  • Experience with multi-tenant environments and security segmentation.

description: Job Title: L3 Data Center Engineer – Cisco ACI Specialist Experience: Minimum 8+ years in the IT Networking Industry Location: Navi Mumbai / Noida / Kolkatta Job Summary: We are seeking an experienced L3 Data Center Engineer – Cisco ACI Specialist with strong expertise in Cisco ACI to design, implement, and maintain advanced network infrastructures. The ideal candidate will have deep technical knowledge of ACI fabric, SD-WAN, Cisco NX-OS, and integration of security & service appliances within ACI deployments. Key Responsibilities: Design, implement, and maintain Cisco ACI fabric, including APIC, Spine, and Leaf components. Configure and manage Tenants, VRFs, EPGs, Contracts, and L3Out in Cisco ACI. Manage and troubleshoot SD-WAN solutions (Cisco Viptela or Meraki preferred). Operate and maintain Cisco NX-OS platforms (Nexus 9K/7K/5K series). Integrate firewalls, load balancers, and other service appliances into ACI environments. Collaborate with cross-functional teams for network planning, capacity, and security. Document network architecture, configurations, and operational procedures. Perform proactive network monitoring, troubleshooting, and optimization. Required Skills & Qualifications: Minimum 8 years of relevant industry experience in network engineering. Strong hands-on experience with Cisco ACI (fabric, policies, L3Out). Proficient in Cisco SD-WAN solutions (Viptela / Meraki preferred). Expertise in Cisco NX-OS for Nexus switches (9K/7K/5K series). Ability to integrate third-party appliances (firewalls, load balancers) into ACI. Excellent troubleshooting skills across Layer 2–7. Strong documentation and communication skills. Relevant certifications preferred (CCNP/CCIE – Data Center or Enterprise). Preferred Skills: Familiarity with automation tools (Python, Ansible) for network operations. Knowledge of ITIL processes for incident, problem, and change management. Experience with multi-tenant environments and security segmentation.

description_html:
Job Title: L2 Data Center Engineer – Cisco ACI (Mumbai)

Experience: Minimum 4 years in the IT Networking Industry

Location: Navi Mumbai

Job Summary:

We are seeking an experienced L2 Data Center Engineer – Cisco ACI (Mumbai) with strong expertise in Cisco ACI to design, implement, and maintain advanced network infrastructures. The ideal candidate will have deep technical knowledge of ACI fabric, SD-WAN, Cisco NX-OS, and integration of security & service appliances within ACI deployments.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, implement, and maintain Cisco ACI fabric, including APIC, Spine, and Leaf components.
  • Configure and manage Tenants, VRFs, EPGs, Contracts, and L3Out in Cisco ACI.
  • Manage and troubleshoot SD-WAN solutions (Cisco Viptela or Meraki preferred).
  • Operate and maintain Cisco NX-OS platforms (Nexus 9K/7K/5K series).
  • Integrate firewalls, load balancers, and other service appliances into ACI environments.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams for network planning, capacity, and security.
  • Document network architecture, configurations, and operational procedures.
  • Perform proactive network monitoring, troubleshooting, and optimization.

Required Skills & Qualifications:

  • Minimum 5 years of relevant industry experience in network engineering.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Cisco ACI (fabric, policies, L3Out).
  • Proficient in Cisco SD-WAN solutions (Viptela / Meraki preferred).
  • Expertise in Cisco NX-OS for Nexus switches (9K/7K/5K series).
  • Ability to integrate third-party appliances (firewalls, load balancers) into ACI.
  • Excellent troubleshooting skills across Layer 2–7.
  • Strong documentation and communication skills.
  • Relevant certifications preferred (CCNP/CCIE – Data Center or Enterprise).

Preferred Skills:

  • Familiarity with automation tools (Python, Ansible) for network operations.
  • Knowledge of ITIL processes for incident, problem, and change management.
  • Experience with multi-tenant environments and security segmentation.

description: Job Title: L2 Data Center Engineer – Cisco ACI (Mumbai) Experience: Minimum 4 years in the IT Networking Industry Location: Navi Mumbai Job Summary: We are seeking an experienced L2 Data Center Engineer – Cisco ACI (Mumbai) with strong expertise in Cisco ACI to design, implement, and maintain advanced network infrastructures. The ideal candidate will have deep technical knowledge of ACI fabric, SD-WAN, Cisco NX-OS, and integration of security & service appliances within ACI deployments. Key Responsibilities: Design, implement, and maintain Cisco ACI fabric, including APIC, Spine, and Leaf components. Configure and manage Tenants, VRFs, EPGs, Contracts, and L3Out in Cisco ACI. Manage and troubleshoot SD-WAN solutions (Cisco Viptela or Meraki preferred). Operate and maintain Cisco NX-OS platforms (Nexus 9K/7K/5K series). Integrate firewalls, load balancers, and other service appliances into ACI environments. Collaborate with cross-functional teams for network planning, capacity, and security. Document network architecture, configurations, and operational procedures. Perform proactive network monitoring, troubleshooting, and optimization. Required Skills & Qualifications: Minimum 5 years of relevant industry experience in network engineering. Strong hands-on experience with Cisco ACI (fabric, policies, L3Out). Proficient in Cisco SD-WAN solutions (Viptela / Meraki preferred). Expertise in Cisco NX-OS for Nexus switches (9K/7K/5K series). Ability to integrate third-party appliances (firewalls, load balancers) into ACI. Excellent troubleshooting skills across Layer 2–7. Strong documentation and communication skills. Relevant certifications preferred (CCNP/CCIE – Data Center or Enterprise). Preferred Skills: Familiarity with automation tools (Python, Ansible) for network operations. Knowledge of ITIL processes for incident, problem, and change management. Experience with multi-tenant environments and security segmentation.

description_html:
Job Title : Technical Project Manager

Location : Navi Mumbai / Noida 135Sector-135 Noida

﻿About the Company / Workplace Environment

The office is based in a modern IT/ITES campus in Noida’s Sector 135 — part of a grade-A tech-park complex with modern infrastructure, good connectivity, and a workplace environment suited for large-scale IT operations.

Role Overview

As an IT Infrastructure Project Manager, you will lead and deliver infrastructure-related projects for CES Tech — overseeing planning, execution, deployment, and maintenance for company’s IT infrastructure. You will coordinate with internal teams, vendors, and stakeholders to ensure that projects are completed on time, within scope and budget, and meet the company’s quality and security standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define project scope, objectives, deliverables, timelines, and resource requirements for infrastructure projects (servers, network, storage, cloud, data-center/DR, security, upgrades).
  • Plan and manage end-to-end project lifecycle: initiation, planning, execution, monitoring, closure.
  • Coordinate with internal IT teams, external vendors/contractors, and other stakeholders.
  • Ensure procurement and deployment of required hardware/software/infrastructure components — manage vendor contracts and relationships.
  • Monitor progress, track milestones, dependencies, and deliverables; report status to senior leadership.
  • Identify, assess and mitigate project risks; manage issues, escalations, and changes.
  • Ensure compliance with company’s IT policies, infrastructure standards, security protocols.
  • Maintain documentation: project plans, high-level/low-level design reviews (HLD/LLD), configuration documents, deployment plans, SOPs, change logs, status reports.
  • Oversee handover, post-deployment support, and ensure smooth operations after project completion.
  • Facilitate coordination for any required audits, security reviews, or compliance checks.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or related discipline (or equivalent).
  • 5–10 years of experience in IT infrastructure projects (servers, networking, cloud, data center, etc.) — ideally including project management responsibility.
  • Strong knowledge of enterprise-level infrastructure: networking, virtualization, storage, cloud (on-prem and/or public), security, DR/backup practices.
  • Proven experience managing projects end-to-end, including vendor coordination and procurement.
  • Familiarity with project management tools and documentation: scheduling, task tracking, design documents, reports.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management — ability to coordinate internal teams and external vendors.
  • Strong planning, risk-management, problem-solving and decision-making skills.
  • Commitment to quality, compliance, and security best practices.
  • Flexibility to handle multiple concurrent infrastructure projects, possibly under tight deadlines.

Preferred Additional Qualifications

  • Certifications such as PMP / PRINCE2 / ITIL or relevant cloud certifications.
  • Experience working in IT/ITES campus-style environment or large corporate infrastructure.
  • Prior experience with vendor management, contracts, procurement, and coordination of third-party services.

Personal & Behavioural Attributes

  • Strong ownership, accountability, and commitment to delivery.
  • Good leadership and team-coordinating ability.
  • Excellent organizational, time-management and prioritization skills.
  • Calm under pressure, with ability to handle multiple tasks and tight deadlines.
  • Collaborative mindset — works well with cross-functional teams and external partners/vendors.

description_html:
Overview

We are seeking an experienced and visionary Technical Solution Architect to lead and manage our entire technical services delivery organization. This critical leadership role is responsible for overseeing the pre-sales, professional services, post-sales support, and technical training functions. The Director will drive operational excellence, ensure the successful delivery of complex IT infrastructure projects, and maintain strong technical partnerships with our key Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs) like Cisco, Fortinet, Palo Alto Networks, and Check Point. The ideal candidate is a strategic leader with deep technical expertise in modern networking, security, and data center technologies.

Key Responsibilities

1. Technical Leadership & Strategy

  • Define and execute the technical services strategy, ensuring alignment with overall business goals and growth objectives.
  • Maintain expert-level knowledge of the latest industry trends and our core technologies, including:
  • Networking: Cisco SD-WAN, Cisco ACI, Cisco Data Center Networks.
  • Security: Next-Generation Firewalls (Palo Alto, FortiGate, Check Point), Zero Trust Architecture.
  • Compute: Server and Storage technologies.
  • Serve as the highest point of technical escalation for complex project issues and client challenges.

2. Service Delivery & Operations

  • Oversee all technical service delivery functions, including project management, implementation, system integration, and support.
  • Develop, implement, and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and service level agreements (SLAs) for the technical team to ensure high quality and timely delivery.
  • Optimize resource allocation and scheduling to maximize utilization and profitability across all projects.
  • Drive process standardization and continuous improvement in service methodologies and documentation.

3. Team Management & Development

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of Technical Consultants, Engineers, and Architects.
  • Manage recruitment, training, and performance reviews for the entire technical services staff.
  • Foster a culture of technical excellence, accountability, and continuous learning regarding OEM products and certifications.

4. Pre-Sales and Client Engagement

  • Partner with the Sales team to provide technical expertise during the pre-sales process, including scoping, effort estimation, and presenting complex solutions to clients.
  • Act as a senior technical trusted advisor for key clients, building and maintaining strong relationships.

5. OEM & Vendor Management

  • Manage technical relationships with core OEMs (Cisco, Fortinet, Palo Alto, Check Point, etc.) to ensure access to the latest roadmaps, training, and support resources.
  • Drive the team to achieve and maintain required partner certifications and specializations.

Required Qualifications & Experience

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in IT services, with at least 5 years in a senior leadership or directorial role managing technical teams in a System Integrator or Managed Services Provider (MSP) environment.
  • Deep technical expertise and hands-on knowledge in multiple areas:
  • Cisco Enterprise Networking (e.g., SD-WAN, Catalyst/Nexus switches).
  • Cisco Data Center (e.g., ACI, UCS/Hyperflex is a plus).
  • Security Architecture (with proficiency in technologies from Fortinet, Palo Alto Networks, and/or Check Point).
  • Proven ability to strategically plan, develop, and implement professional services methodologies.
  • Exceptional leadership, communication, and client-facing skills.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field (Master’s degree preferred).
  • Relevant industry certifications (e.g., CCNP/CCIE, Fortinet NSE, PCNSE, CISSP, ITIL) are highly desirable.

Success Factors

The successful Technical Services Director will be defined by their ability to:

  • Consistently achieve high client satisfaction and technical service delivery quality.
  • Effectively scale the technical team and services to support business growth.
  • Drive profitability and efficiency in project delivery and support operations.
  • Maintain the highest level of technical competency within the organization.

Security: Next-Generation Firewalls (Palo Alto, FortiGate, Check Point), Zero Trust Architecture. Compute: Server and Storage technologies. Serve as the highest point of technical escalation for complex project issues and client challenges. 2. Service Delivery & Operations Oversee all technical service delivery functions, including project management, implementation, system integration, and support. Develop, implement, and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and service level agreements (SLAs) for the technical team to ensure high quality and timely delivery. Optimize resource allocation and scheduling to maximize utilization and profitability across all projects. Drive process standardization and continuous improvement in service methodologies and documentation. 3. Team Management & Development Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of Technical Consultants, Engineers, and Architects. Manage recruitment, training, and performance reviews for the entire technical services staff. Foster a culture of technical excellence, accountability, and continuous learning regarding OEM products and certifications. 4. Pre-Sales and Client Engagement Partner with the Sales team to provide technical expertise during the pre-sales process, including scoping, effort estimation, and presenting complex solutions to clients. Act as a senior technical trusted advisor for key clients, building and maintaining strong relationships. 5. OEM & Vendor Management Manage technical relationships with core OEMs (Cisco, Fortinet, Palo Alto, Check Point, etc.) to ensure access to the latest roadmaps, training, and support resources. Drive the team to achieve and maintain required partner certifications and specializations. Required Qualifications & Experience 10+ years of progressive experience in IT services, with at least 5 years in a senior leadership or directorial role managing technical teams in a System Integrator or Managed Services Provider (MSP) environment. Deep technical expertise and hands-on knowledge in multiple areas: Cisco Enterprise Networking (e.g., SD-WAN, Catalyst/Nexus switches). Cisco Data Center (e.g., ACI, UCS/Hyperflex is a plus). Security Architecture (with proficiency in technologies from Fortinet, Palo Alto Networks, and/or Check Point). Proven ability to strategically plan, develop, and implement professional services methodologies. Exceptional leadership, communication, and client-facing skills. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field (Master’s degree preferred). Relevant industry certifications (e.g., CCNP/CCIE, Fortinet NSE, PCNSE, CISSP, ITIL) are highly desirable. Success Factors The successful Technical Services Director will be defined by their ability to: Consistently achieve high client satisfaction and technical service delivery quality. Effectively scale the technical team and services to support business growth. Drive profitability and efficiency in project delivery and support operations. Maintain the highest level of technical competency within the organization.

Employment Type: Full-Time

Job Summary

We are looking for a skilled and motivated Cisco UC Engineer with 4–5 years of hands-on experience in Cisco Unified Communications and Collaboration technologies. The candidate will be responsible for deployment, configuration, troubleshooting, and support of enterprise voice and collaboration infrastructure across customer environments.

The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in Cisco UC technologies including CUCM, Unity Connection, IM&P, Voice Gateways, SIP, and VoIP troubleshooting, along with excellent communication and customer-handling skills.

Key Responsibilities

  • Configure, manage, and troubleshoot Cisco Unified Communications solutions including CUCM, Unity Connection, IM&P, Expressway, and Jabber/Webex.
  • Support VoIP infrastructure including SIP trunks, dial plans, voice gateways, and call routing.
  • Perform installation, upgrades, patches, migrations, and maintenance activities for Cisco UC platforms.
  • Troubleshoot voice quality issues such as latency, jitter, packet loss, and call failures using tools like RTMT and Wireshark.
  • Handle incident management, root cause analysis, and resolution of escalated UC issues.
  • Coordinate with OEM/TAC support teams for complex technical cases.
  • Manage Cisco IP Phones, video conferencing devices, and collaboration endpoints.
  • Ensure high availability and optimal performance of UC infrastructure.
  • Maintain technical documentation, network diagrams, SOPs, and change records.
  • Work closely with network, security, and project teams during implementation and migration activities.

Required Skills

  • Strong hands-on experience with:
  • Cisco CUCM
  • Cisco Unity Connection
  • Cisco IM & Presence (IM&P)
  • Cisco Voice Gateways / CUBE
  • Cisco Jabber / Webex
  • SIP, SCCP, RTP, SRST, and VoIP technologies

  • Knowledge of Cisco Expressway, UCCX, or MS Teams integration will be an added advantage.

  • Cisco Collaboration certifications preferred.


Educational Qualification

  • Collaborative and technology-driven work environment
  • Career growth and certification support opportunities

You will be responsible for identifying new business opportunities, nurturing client relationships, and driving revenue growth. This role is perfect for someone who has spent a year or two in the industry and is ready to take on more ownership in a fast-paced environment. Key Responsibilities Lead Generation: Proactively identify and qualify new B2B sales leads through cold calling, LinkedIn networking, and industry referrals. Client Consultation: Understand client business challenges and pitch tailored IT infrastructure solutions (Hardware, Networking, Cloud, or AMC services). Sales Cycle Management: Manage the full sales funnel—from the first "hello" to proposal submission and closing the deal. Relationship Building: Maintain and grow relationships with existing clients to ensure repeat business and referrals. Collaboration: Work closely with our technical engineers to ensure the solutions proposed are technically viable and meet client needs. Market Intelligence: Stay updated on industry trends (like India’s digital growth) and competitor offerings to position our services effectively. Reporting: Maintain accurate records in the CRM and provide weekly updates on the sales pipeline. Required Skills & Qualifications Experience: 10+ years of experience in B2B sales, specifically within the IT Infrastructure, Hardware, or Software sectors. Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or a technical field (B.Tech/BCA/BSc). Technical Familiarity: Basic understanding of Data Centers, Networking (Cisco/Juniper), Servers (Dell/HP), and Cloud concepts. Communication: Exceptional verbal and written English/Hindi communication skills; ability to explain technical concepts simply. Soft Skills: High resilience, "hunter" mindset, and the ability to handle rejection with a positive attitude. Tools: Proficiency in LinkedIn Sales Navigator and any standard CRM (HubSpot, Zoho, or Salesforce). What We Offer Competitive base salary + performance-linked incentives. A chance to be an early member of a growing startup. Direct mentorship from the leadership team. A fast-track path to Lead Sales or Account Management roles.
