description_html:
Job Title: L2 Data Center Engineer – Cisco ACI Specialist

Experience: Minimum 4+ years in the IT Networking Industry

Location: Navi Mumbai / Noida / Kolkatta

Job Summary:

We are seeking an experienced L2 Data Center Engineer – Cisco ACI Specialist with strong expertise in Cisco ACI to design, implement, and maintain advanced network infrastructures. The ideal candidate will have deep technical knowledge of ACI fabric, SD-WAN, Cisco NX-OS, and integration of security & service appliances within ACI deployments.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, implement, and maintain Cisco ACI fabric, including APIC, Spine, and Leaf components.
  • Configure and manage Tenants, VRFs, EPGs, Contracts, and L3Out in Cisco ACI.
  • Manage and troubleshoot SD-WAN solutions (Cisco Viptela or Meraki preferred).
  • Operate and maintain Cisco NX-OS platforms (Nexus 9K/7K/5K series).
  • Integrate firewalls, load balancers, and other service appliances into ACI environments.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams for network planning, capacity, and security.
  • Document network architecture, configurations, and operational procedures.
  • Perform proactive network monitoring, troubleshooting, and optimization.

Required Skills & Qualifications:

  • Minimum 4 years of relevant industry experience in network engineering.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Cisco ACI (fabric, policies, L3Out).
  • Proficient in Cisco SD-WAN solutions (Viptela / Meraki preferred).
  • Expertise in Cisco NX-OS for Nexus switches (9K/7K/5K series).
  • Ability to integrate third-party appliances (firewalls, load balancers) into ACI.
  • Excellent troubleshooting skills across Layer 2–7.
  • Strong documentation and communication skills.
  • Relevant certifications preferred (CCNP/CCIE – Data Center or Enterprise).

Preferred Skills:

  • Familiarity with automation tools (Python, Ansible) for network operations.
  • Knowledge of ITIL processes for incident, problem, and change management.
  • Experience with multi-tenant environments and security segmentation.

description: Job Title: L2 Data Center Engineer – Cisco ACI Specialist Experience: Minimum 4+ years in the IT Networking Industry Location: Navi Mumbai / Noida / Kolkatta Job Summary: We are seeking an experienced L2 Data Center Engineer – Cisco ACI Specialist with strong expertise in Cisco ACI to design, implement, and maintain advanced network infrastructures. The ideal candidate will have deep technical knowledge of ACI fabric, SD-WAN, Cisco NX-OS, and integration of security & service appliances within ACI deployments. Key Responsibilities: Design, implement, and maintain Cisco ACI fabric, including APIC, Spine, and Leaf components. Configure and manage Tenants, VRFs, EPGs, Contracts, and L3Out in Cisco ACI. Manage and troubleshoot SD-WAN solutions (Cisco Viptela or Meraki preferred). Operate and maintain Cisco NX-OS platforms (Nexus 9K/7K/5K series). Integrate firewalls, load balancers, and other service appliances into ACI environments. Collaborate with cross-functional teams for network planning, capacity, and security. Document network architecture, configurations, and operational procedures. Perform proactive network monitoring, troubleshooting, and optimization. Required Skills & Qualifications: Minimum 4 years of relevant industry experience in network engineering. Strong hands-on experience with Cisco ACI (fabric, policies, L3Out). Proficient in Cisco SD-WAN solutions (Viptela / Meraki preferred). Expertise in Cisco NX-OS for Nexus switches (9K/7K/5K series). Ability to integrate third-party appliances (firewalls, load balancers) into ACI. Excellent troubleshooting skills across Layer 2–7. Strong documentation and communication skills. Relevant certifications preferred (CCNP/CCIE – Data Center or Enterprise). Preferred Skills: Familiarity with automation tools (Python, Ansible) for network operations. Knowledge of ITIL processes for incident, problem, and change management. Experience with multi-tenant environments and security segmentation.

profile.description: Job Description – Senior Network & Security Engineer (Cisco) Location: Kolkata Experience: 10+ Years Position: Senior Network & Security Engineer / L3 Engineer Employment Type: Full-Time / On-Site Role Overview We are looking for an experienced Senior Network & Security Engineer with 10+ years of hands-on experience in enterprise networking and security infrastructure. The candidate will be responsible for managing, troubleshooting, configuring, and optimizing a large-scale Cisco Network & Security environment. The ideal candidate should have strong practical experience in Cisco Wireless, Cisco Switching, Cisco FTD/FMC, Cisco ISE, and Cisco Secure Network Analytics (SNA) and should be capable of independently handling L2/L3 and security-related technical issues. The role requires strong troubleshooting skills, ownership of incidents, coordination with OEM/TAC teams, and the ability to work in a critical production environment. Key Responsibilities 1.⁠ ⁠Cisco Wireless Manage and support enterprise Cisco Wireless LAN infrastructure with on-premises Wireless LAN Controllers (WLC). Configure and troubleshoot Cisco WLCs and associated Access Points. Troubleshoot AP registration, CAPWAP, authentication, roaming, RF, channel utilization, interference, and client connectivity issues. Configure and troubleshoot WLANs, SSIDs, AAA, security policies, RF profiles, FlexConnect, and QoS. Analyze wireless client connectivity and performance issues. Perform firmware/IOS-XE upgrades of WLCs and Access Points following approved change procedures. Perform wireless health checks, optimization, and capacity analysis. Troubleshoot 802.1X authentication issues involving Cisco ISE. Analyze WLC logs, client debugs, RF statistics, and packet captures. 2.⁠ ⁠Cisco FTD / FMC Hands-on administration of Cisco Firepower Threat Defense (FTD) firewalls managed through Cisco Firepower Management Center (FMC). Configure and troubleshoot Access Control Policies, NAT, VPN, Security Intelligence, SSL inspection, and related security policies. Troubleshoot site-to-site IPsec VPN and Remote Access VPN issues. Manage firewall objects, policies, NAT rules, routing, and interfaces. Perform firewall health checks and performance monitoring. Analyze firewall events, connection logs, intrusion events, and troubleshooting outputs. Perform FTD software upgrades and configuration changes as per approved change procedures. Troubleshoot complex traffic-flow and application connectivity issues. Coordinate with Cisco TAC for critical firewall incidents and software-related issues. Ensure proper configuration backup and change documentation. 3.⁠ ⁠Cisco ISE Hands-on experience with Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE). Configure and troubleshoot 802.1X authentication and authorization for wired and wireless networks. Experience with AAA, RADIUS, TACACS+, Network Access Devices (NADs), authentication policies, authorization profiles, and policy sets. Troubleshoot endpoint authentication and authorization failures. Work with Active Directory/LDAP integration and certificate-based authentication. Troubleshoot guest access, profiling, posture, and endpoint identity-related issues where applicable. Monitor ISE health, authentication logs, Live Logs, alarms, and system performance. Support ISE upgrades, patching, backup, and recovery activities. Troubleshoot integration issues between ISE, WLC, switches, and other network/security

description_html:
Job Description – Senior Network & Security Engineer (Cisco)

  • Location: Kolkata
  • Experience: 10+ Years
  • Position: Senior Network & Security Engineer / L3 Engineer
  • Employment Type: Full-Time / On-Site

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced Senior Network & Security Engineer with 10+ years of hands-on experience in enterprise networking and security infrastructure. The candidate will be responsible for managing, troubleshooting, configuring, and optimizing a large-scale Cisco Network & Security environment.

The ideal candidate should have strong practical experience in Cisco Wireless, Cisco Switching, Cisco FTD/FMC, Cisco ISE, and Cisco Secure Network Analytics (SNA) and should be capable of independently handling L2/L3 and security-related technical issues.

The role requires strong troubleshooting skills, ownership of incidents, coordination with OEM/TAC teams, and the ability to work in a critical production environment.

Key Responsibilities

1.⁠ ⁠Cisco Wireless

  1. Manage and support enterprise Cisco Wireless LAN infrastructure with on-premises Wireless LAN Controllers (WLC).
  2. Configure and troubleshoot Cisco WLCs and associated Access Points.
  3. Troubleshoot AP registration, CAPWAP, authentication, roaming, RF, channel utilization, interference, and client connectivity issues.
  4. Configure and troubleshoot WLANs, SSIDs, AAA, security policies, RF profiles, FlexConnect, and QoS.
  5. Analyze wireless client connectivity and performance issues.
  6. Perform firmware/IOS-XE upgrades of WLCs and Access Points following approved change procedures.
  7. Perform wireless health checks, optimization, and capacity analysis.
  8. Troubleshoot 802.1X authentication issues involving Cisco ISE.
  9. Analyze WLC logs, client debugs, RF statistics, and packet captures.

2.⁠ ⁠Cisco FTD / FMC

  1. Hands-on administration of Cisco Firepower Threat Defense (FTD) firewalls managed through Cisco Firepower Management Center (FMC).
  2. Configure and troubleshoot Access Control Policies, NAT, VPN, Security Intelligence, SSL inspection, and related security policies.
  3. Troubleshoot site-to-site IPsec VPN and Remote Access VPN issues.
  4. Manage firewall objects, policies, NAT rules, routing, and interfaces.
  5. Perform firewall health checks and performance monitoring.
  6. Analyze firewall events, connection logs, intrusion events, and troubleshooting outputs.
  7. Perform FTD software upgrades and configuration changes as per approved change procedures.
  8. Troubleshoot complex traffic-flow and application connectivity issues.
  9. Coordinate with Cisco TAC for critical firewall incidents and software-related issues.
  10. Ensure proper configuration backup and change documentation.

3.⁠ ⁠Cisco ISE

  1. Hands-on experience with Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE).
  2. Configure and troubleshoot 802.1X authentication and authorization for wired and wireless networks.
  3. Experience with AAA, RADIUS, TACACS+, Network Access Devices (NADs), authentication policies, authorization profiles, and policy sets.
  4. Troubleshoot endpoint authentication and authorization failures.
  5. Work with Active Directory/LDAP integration and certificate-based authentication.
  6. Troubleshoot guest access, profiling, posture, and endpoint identity-related issues where applicable.
  7. Monitor ISE health, authentication logs, Live Logs, alarms, and system performance.
  8. Support ISE upgrades, patching, backup, and recovery activities.
  9. Troubleshoot integration issues between ISE, WLC, switches, and other network/security

description: Job Description – Senior Network & Security Engineer (Cisco) Location: Kolkata Experience: 10+ Years Position: Senior Network & Security Engineer / L3 Engineer Employment Type: Full-Time / On-Site Role Overview We are looking for an experienced Senior Network & Security Engineer with 10+ years of hands-on experience in enterprise networking and security infrastructure. The candidate will be responsible for managing, troubleshooting, configuring, and optimizing a large-scale Cisco Network & Security environment. The ideal candidate should have strong practical experience in Cisco Wireless, Cisco Switching, Cisco FTD/FMC, Cisco ISE, and Cisco Secure Network Analytics (SNA) and should be capable of independently handling L2/L3 and security-related technical issues. The role requires strong troubleshooting skills, ownership of incidents, coordination with OEM/TAC teams, and the ability to work in a critical production environment. Key Responsibilities 1.⁠ ⁠Cisco Wireless Manage and support enterprise Cisco Wireless LAN infrastructure with on-premises Wireless LAN Controllers (WLC). Configure and troubleshoot Cisco WLCs and associated Access Points. Troubleshoot AP registration, CAPWAP, authentication, roaming, RF, channel utilization, interference, and client connectivity issues. Configure and troubleshoot WLANs, SSIDs, AAA, security policies, RF profiles, FlexConnect, and QoS. Analyze wireless client connectivity and performance issues. Perform firmware/IOS-XE upgrades of WLCs and Access Points following approved change procedures. Perform wireless health checks, optimization, and capacity analysis. Troubleshoot 802.1X authentication issues involving Cisco ISE. Analyze WLC logs, client debugs, RF statistics, and packet captures. 2.⁠ ⁠Cisco FTD / FMC Hands-on administration of Cisco Firepower Threat Defense (FTD) firewalls managed through Cisco Firepower Management Center (FMC). Configure and troubleshoot Access Control Policies, NAT, VPN, Security Intelligence, SSL inspection, and related security policies. Troubleshoot site-to-site IPsec VPN and Remote Access VPN issues. Manage firewall objects, policies, NAT rules, routing, and interfaces. Perform firewall health checks and performance monitoring. Analyze firewall events, connection logs, intrusion events, and troubleshooting outputs. Perform FTD software upgrades and configuration changes as per approved change procedures. Troubleshoot complex traffic-flow and application connectivity issues. Coordinate with Cisco TAC for critical firewall incidents and software-related issues. Ensure proper configuration backup and change documentation. 3.⁠ ⁠Cisco ISE Hands-on experience with Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE). Configure and troubleshoot 802.1X authentication and authorization for wired and wireless networks. Experience with AAA, RADIUS, TACACS+, Network Access Devices (NADs), authentication policies, authorization profiles, and policy sets. Troubleshoot endpoint authentication and authorization failures. Work with Active Directory/LDAP integration and certificate-based authentication. Troubleshoot guest access, profiling, posture, and endpoint identity-related issues where applicable. Monitor ISE health, authentication logs, Live Logs, alarms, and system performance. Support ISE upgrades, patching, backup, and recovery activities. Troubleshoot integration issues between ISE, WLC, switches, and other network/security
